item.title: Hunt For New Lower-Cost Strike Missile With 1,000-Kilometer Range Underway By U.S. Army
item.summary: Affordable High Speed Strike missiles could offer an important new way to hold enemy air bases, air defense nodes, and other high-value targets at risk. The post Hunt For New Lower-Cost Strike Missile With 1,000-Kilometer Range Underway By U.S. Army appeared first on TWZ .
